scope: Complete original-base-to-head diff across all five changed paths.

review_method.independent: Read-only inspection of implementation, callers, tests, documentation and saved logs. Verified HEAD, clean working tree and a whitespace-clean base-to-head diff.
review_method.execution: No tests, builds, formatting, edits or child agents.
review_method.evidence_limit: Test results below are saved builder execution evidence, inspected by this reviewer. They are not independently executed proof.

evidence.assessment: Refresh has no audio-command or binding wait. Existing local writes remain awaited. Account-generation, restoration, pending-write, closure and record-revision guards protect adoption. Generation is captured before waiting, protecting account A to B to A transitions.

Rejected Playback reads do not call acceptSnapshot. Adoption advances the existing record revision, preventing an older recovery read from replacing a snapshot already adopted by sync. Store ownership of stale signals and accepted snapshots remains intact.

evidence.check: Confirmed decoder position and command persistence
evidence.assessment: Refresh does not operate the decoder. Audited audio mutations use current live records after their waits and preserve command-owned saves. Tests check received records and unchanged decoder position before release, then command persistence before a later flush or exchange.

evidence.check: Undo, deletion, pending writes and lifecycle
evidence.assessment: Undo refers to the adopted history object or clears after deletion. Local changes and failed writes remain protected. Account return, close, deletion during a read and successful retry have focused coverage. The independent flush contract is unchanged.

Ordinary refresh exceptions remain reportable without stopping audio. Programming Errors propagate. Complete and rejected-upload exchanges use the same awaited refresh path; exchange failure reporting is preserved.

validation_gaps: Runtime conclusions rely on inspected saved executions and static reasoning; independent execution was prohibited.
Native-device behavior and latency were not assessed and are outside this ticket's review gate.

evidence.requirement: Two completed sync operations receiving listening records during held load, seek and pause
evidence.assessment: Covered for complete and rejected-upload outcomes on preferences and SQLite. Assertions occur before releasing the controlled audio command.

evidence.requirement: Durable and live preservation, confirmed position, command-owned persistence and reopen
evidence.assessment: Covered by live-state checks, fresh-store reads, direct observation of command saves and an actual SQLite connection close/reopen.

evidence.requirement: Binding, account return, read/write races, retry, close, Undo, deletion and overlapping recovery
evidence.assessment: New cases and retained regressions cover the specified preservation requirements.

evidence.requirement: Meaningful failure evidence and required verification
evidence.assessment: Inspected held-command timeout failures, the separate Undo-object failure, both overlapping-refresh bookmark-loss failures, and their subsequent passing evidence. Initial compilation errors and the original close-cleanup defect remain disclosed.

saved_results.analysis-format-final.log: No analysis issues; both Dart files unchanged by formatting

evidence.assessment: Production changes remain within Playback refresh. No new writer, pending-action inventory, queue framework, record-type rewrite or Ask-at-Play behavior. Store, coordinator, reader and integrated boo-gcu6 code are unchanged. Documentation records the contract, commands, failures and limits.

validation_gaps: Existing opt-in live-plugin, corpus and benchmark skips remain unexecuted.
Parent-owned acceptance, hardening, integration and closure remain outstanding by explicit task boundary.

evidence.source: User: one coherent model and one owner per state
evidence.assessment: Playback retains ownership of live records and decoder position; LocalResumeStore retains durable records and snapshot acceptance; RecordSync retains exchange completion and reporting. No parallel authority or caller-owned adoption sequence was introduced.

evidence.source: Ousterhout: information hiding and deep interfaces
evidence.assessment: The existing refresh interface hides account lifetime, local-write and overlapping-read coordination. Callers need no new flags or knowledge of audio scheduling. Adoption keeps history, bookmarks, resumes, Undo and revision maintenance together.

evidence.source: Muratori: reuse existing paths and avoid speculative machinery
evidence.assessment: The correction reuses the existing record revision and guarded owner model. It introduces no second queue or revision field. Future refresh-policy changes remain localized rather than requiring edits to each sync caller.

validation_gaps: Whole-list decoding remains existing work tracked by boo-w6m2; no off-isolate performance claim is made.
Coverage and mutation testing were explicitly reserved for the parent.

readiness: Passes the requested read-only review gate. No blocking findings or material unverified in-scope requirements.
